title: Direct Substitution into a Polynomial
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate the limit lim_{x -> -2} (2x^3 - 5x + 4) using the limit laws.

steps.title: Apply the Sum and Difference Limit Laws
steps.explanation: Distribute the limit operator across the individual polynomial terms using linearity of limits.
steps.why: Limit of a linear combination of functions is the linear combination of individual limits.

steps.title: Evaluate Each Power Limit
steps.explanation: Substitute x = -2 directly into each term by the direct substitution property of polynomials.
steps.why: Every polynomial function is continuous everywhere on the real line.
